name: springbloom_druid_trades_a_land_for_two_basics_tapped
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.' Seat 0 controls two Forests and sacrifices one of them (the other stays). Its library holds Evolving Wilds (a nonbasic land), a Forest and a Plains; the search takes the first legal card twice: the Wilds is no basic land card, so the Forest and the Plains come, both tapped. The Wilds stays in the library.
